# Pipeline trust report (V03)

Every stage between Zig source and a kernel-checked theorem, with one class each. Premise IDs
are defined in [premises.md](premises.md). Regenerate with `python3 scripts/trust-report.py write`;
CI runs `python3 scripts/trust-report.py check`, which also fails on a missing stage, class,
premise, checker or test, or a check whose test CI does not run.

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `kernel-checked` | The Lean kernel checks the statement. Trusted base: the cited premises (TRU-01 at least). |
| `independently-checked-metadata` | A checker that shares no code with the stage re-checks its output metadata (structure, identity, inventory). Semantic preservation stays with the cited premises. |
| `unverified-assumption` | Believed, not checked. The cited premises state the assumption. |

## kernel-checked

### Debug definition-ID mapping of reified normalized AIR

One generic theorem proves that mapping only debug definition IDs in any reified normalized Func preserves the complete Sem.execFunc result for every same arbitrary oracle, argument list and start memory. The equality is vacuous when both executions are stuck, including outside Sem's fragment or with unresolved references; it does not establish defined execution or semantic-fragment coverage. The generic theorem is kernel-checked once at ordinary Lean limits and freshly replayed by the independent checker. Actual per-case structural native comparisons are binding evidence under TRU-02, not repeated kernel proofs. CanonCertificate.lean, Canon.lean as a whole, Raw/snapshot binding, decoding, normalization, serialization and the remaining rewrites retain TRU-02.

- Components: `Air2Lean/CanonSem.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-01](premises.md#tru-01), [SEM-06](premises.md#sem-06), [SEM-01](premises.md#sem-01), [SEM-02](premises.md#sem-02), [SEM-03](premises.md#sem-03), [TRU-04](premises.md#tru-04)
- Check: generic debug-ID erasure and full execution equality, exact generic-module artifact binding and fresh independent kernel replay; native per-case comparisons are separate TRU-02 evidence: `scripts/assumptions.sh`, tested by `tests/roadmap/gen-integrity/test_certification.py` (CI: `python3 -I -B scripts/gen-integrity.py certify`, `python3 -I -B tests/roadmap/gen-integrity/test_certification.py`)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `tests/roadmap/air-semantics/RenumberOracle.lean`, `docs/air-semantics.md`

### Theorems over generated modules and the ZigLean library

Every shipped theorem about the generated Lean module, and every runtime lemma it uses, is checked by the Lean kernel, and every non-toolchain module of each audited dependency closure is replayed by the toolchain's independent leanchecker, so an elaborator bypass (debug.skipKernelTC) cannot enter the evidence. Every module the premise index lists (tutorials, case studies, tests/roadmap) is audited the same way. The audited dependency closure may use only the standard axioms and reviewed opaques. This is preservation inside the model only.

- Components: `Proofs`, `ZigLean`
- Premises: [TRU-01](premises.md#tru-01), [TRU-04](premises.md#tru-04)
- Check: kernel build of Proofs, then dependency/axiom/opaque/extern audit of the checked environment: `scripts/assumptions.sh`, tested by `tests/roadmap/assurance/test_policy.py` (CI: `lake build Proofs`, `scripts/assumptions.sh --output`, `tests/roadmap/assurance/check.sh`)
- Check: kernel replay of every audited module and compiled audit of every indexed theorem module: `scripts/theorem_universe.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/theorem-universe/test_universe.py` (CI: `scripts/theorem_universe.py audit`, `tests/roadmap/theorem-universe/test_universe.py`)
- Check: per-theorem premise derivation and index: `scripts/premises.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/premises/test_premises.py` (CI: `scripts/premises.py check`, `tests/roadmap/premises/test_premises.py`)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/no-sorry.sh`, `assurance/policy.json`

## independently-checked-metadata

### AIR JSON exporter patch

The exported structure is re-checked outside the Lean decoder: instruction ids, operand scoping, block/loop/dispatch targets, terminators, type-table/global references and the per-version tag set and unsupported markers of coverage/<version>.json. Operand values and the meaning of each tag remain trusted.

- Components: `zig-patch/air-json/json.zig`, `zig-patch/air-json/pointer-offset.zig`, `zig-patch/air-json/identity.zig`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02)
- Check: independent structural validation of every committed golden AIR file: `scripts/validate-air.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/export-validation/test_validate_air.py` (CI: `python3 -B scripts/validate-air.py`, `tests/roadmap/export-validation/test_validate_air.py`)
- Check: compiler-derived AIR tag/type inventory generated twice, identically, from checksum-pinned compiler sources on the tested tree (scripts/generated.py; docs/ci.md#whole-tree-generated-files): `scripts/coverage.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/inventory/test_inventory.py` (CI: `scripts/generated.py produce --group coverage`, `tests/roadmap/inventory/test_inventory.py`)
- Check: exported filename identity, re-export and collision contract: `scripts/check-export-names.sh`, tested by `tests/roadmap/export-names/test_order_cli.py` (CI: `bash scripts/check-export-names.sh`)

### Artifact provenance (source, patch, AIR, profile, Gen.lean, runtime, toolchain)

Hash links between the artifacts of one run are recomputed and staleness is named per link. Identity is checked; correspondence between the linked artifacts is not. A manifest or receipt is authenticated only by an attestation (an SSH signature) checked against the verifier's own allowed signers; without one it is unauthenticated.

- Components: `scripts/artifact-manifest.py`, `scripts/attest.py`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02), [TRU-05](premises.md#tru-05)
- Check: chained manifest hashes and per-link staleness: `scripts/artifact-manifest.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/artifact-manifest/test_manifest.py` (CI: `tests/roadmap/artifact-manifest/test_manifest.py`)
- Check: signed manifests and receipts: signature, trust anchor, subject digests and tamper rejection: `scripts/attest.py`, tested by `tests/roadmap/attestation/test_attestation.py` (CI: `tests/roadmap/attestation/test_attestation.py`)

## unverified-assumption

### Zig Sema (source to analyzed AIR)

The pinned upstream compiler's semantic analysis is believed to produce AIR that means what the Zig source means. Nothing relates source to AIR except bounded native/model differential tests.

- Components: `zig-patch/versions.toml`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/diff.sh`

### JSON decode and schema/profile validation

Decoding is unproved Lean code. Its rejection policy (V05) is regression-tested; that the decoded value is the exported AIR is trusted. The independent validator checks the same input, not the decoder's output.

- Components: `Air2Lean/Air/StrictJson.lean`, `Air2Lean/Air/Json.lean`, `Air2Lean/Air/Profile.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02), [PRF-02](premises.md#prf-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `tests/roadmap/input-validation/test_cli.py`, `tests/roadmap/input-validation/Validation.lean`

### Canonicalization (reference validation, copy forwarding, renumbering)

The Raw pipeline's connection to normalized snapshots, live-ID and operand renumbering, reference validation, copy forwarding and the other rewrites remain unproved (V02 research). The separate debug-ID stage certifies only the stated mapping of reified Func values. Complete structural native comparisons bind actual before/after snapshots to that map as evidence, not a kernel proof of Raw, decoding, normalization or serialization.

- Components: `Air2Lean/Air/Canon.lean`, `Air2Lean/CanonCertificate.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/check.sh`, `scripts/mutate.sh`, `scripts/gen-integrity.py`, `Air2Lean/CanonCertificate.lean`, `tests/roadmap/air-semantics/CanonBinding.lean`

### Per-version tag normalization

The mapping from verbatim per-version AIR tags to Op constructors is unproved. scripts/normalize-air.py only normalizes identities for golden comparison and is not a check of this stage.

- Components: `Air2Lean/Air/Normalize.lean`, `Air2Lean/Air/Compat.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/check.sh`, `coverage/0.16.0.json`

### Whole-program checker

Type, layout, global and call restrictions are enforced by unproved Lean code; acceptance does not certify that the admitted program is in the modeled subset.

- Components: `Air2Lean/Check.lean`, `Air2Lean/AsmContract.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02), [PRF-01](premises.md#prf-01), [PRF-02](premises.md#prf-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `tests/roadmap/input-validation/test_cli.py`

### Lean emitter (Gen.lean)

Emission is not proved to preserve the canonical AIR. Evidence is golden Gen.lean comparison, mutation tests and bounded differential tests. Undefined values stay explicit: a store of `undefined` to a local is either a dead store (overwritten before any read) or the local becomes a byte local (`Zig.Bytes T`) whose undefined bytes read as `.unspecified`; partly undefined constant operands and global initializers are explicit undefined bytes or rejected (tests/roadmap/undef-locals, tests/roadmap/undef-operands).

- Components: `Air2Lean/Emit.lean`
- Premises: [TRU-02](premises.md#tru-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/check.sh`, `scripts/diff.sh`, `scripts/mutate.sh`

### ZigLean runtime semantics (model fidelity)

The runtime definitions are the meaning given to generated code. That they match Zig's semantics is a model choice; opaque/extern/implemented_by bodies are reviewed, not proved.

- Components: `ZigLean/Basic.lean`, `ZigLean/Mem/Basic.lean`, `ZigLean/Loop.lean`
- Premises: [SEM-01](premises.md#sem-01), [SEM-02](premises.md#sem-02), [SEM-03](premises.md#sem-03), [TRU-04](premises.md#tru-04)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `assurance/policy.json`, `docs/premises.md`

### Lean kernel and toolchain

The pinned Lean kernel and the three standard axioms are the trusted base of every kernel-checked statement.

- Components: `lean-toolchain`
- Premises: [TRU-01](premises.md#tru-01)

### Native backend, linker, OS and hardware

Proofs concern AIR before code generation. Native behavior is related to the model only by bounded differential runs and ABI-probe observations for named targets.

- Components: `zig-patch/versions.toml`
- Premises: [TRU-03](premises.md#tru-03), [PRF-02](premises.md#prf-02)
- Further evidence (not a check of this stage): `scripts/diff.sh`, `scripts/abi-probe.py`
